Cutover day control

For the day (or night) when everything switches over: IT migration, office move, site opening, equipment commissioning, warehouse change. A minute-by-minute run sheet with owners and dependencies that recalculates as soon as a step starts or ends, go/no-go decisions on criteria written in advance, hold points, a rollback plan with its decision deadline (end of window minus rollback duration), a time-stamped incident log and a live view readable on a phone. Five generic sample sequences to adapt; status report to copy, run sheet to print.
